decision.title: 's exclusions are delays, not non-goals (owner)
decision.summary: The features leaves out are delayed, not dropped: schema awareness stays Phase 5, the rest becomes Phase 7, and until then each is rejected or ignored in one place with the specification's error.

body.p: on the owner's word: " is accepted only as a delay -- these features need to be supported ultimately." Amends and the "Not in year one" list of PLAN.md.

item.p: still fixes what Phases 2 to 4 deliver and what their gates count (); nothing in those phases changes.

Everything leaves out is owed later, not dropped: full UCA (DUCET, tailoring, numeric and case-order options; advanced-uca-fallback), fn:parse-html and fn:html-doc (an HTML5 tree builder), invisible XML, schema awareness (validate, XSLT validation and type attributes), streaming, the XQuery Update Facility, Full Text, EXPath, XPath 1.0 compatibility mode and XSLT backwards-compatible behaviour, civil-timezone and Olson names (a timezone database), calendars other than AD and ISO and languages other than English in the formatting functions, and fn:transform.

Schema awareness stays Phase 5. The rest becomes Phase 7 ("Deferred features" in PLAN.md), planned in docs/tasks/phase-7.md after the Phase 4 gate, one packet per feature, each with its QT4 or xslt40-test sets counted once it lands.

Until then, code that rejects or ignores one of these features does it in one place each, with the error the specification gives a processor without the feature, so that adding it later replaces that place instead of unpicking special cases (the design principle in CLAUDE.md). Size-driven choices (UCA tables, a timezone database, HTML5) are revisited against the wasm budget then; a feature may be a build option.
